function.name: BmpFrameDecode_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface supports the requested interface ID (IID). If it does, it returns a pointer to that interface; otherwise, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICBitmapFrameDecode interface.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface ID to query for.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid. Upon successful return, *ppv contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppv is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if not, and E_INVALIDARG if ppv is NULL.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_AddRef
function.description: This function is used to add a reference to a BMP frame decoder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an interface of a bitmap frame decoder.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the bitmap decoder object after the function call.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_Release
function.description: This function releases the Bitmap Decoder from the given Bitmap Frame Decode interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the Bitmap Frame Decode interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the status of the Bitmap Decoder release operation.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_GetSize
function.description: This function decodes the size of a bitmap frame. It checks the size of the BITMAPCOREHEADER structure and accordingly assigns the width and height to the passed pointers.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a bitmap frame that needs to be decoded

parameters.name: puiWidth
parameters.description: Pointer to store the decoded width of the bitmap frame

parameters.name: puiHeight
parameters.description: Pointer to store the decoded height of the bitmap frame

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_GetPixelFormat
function.description: This function retrieves the pixel format of a bitmap frame.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface for decoding bitmap frames.

parameters.name: pPixelFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the pixel format of the bitmap frame.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful.

function.name: BmpHeader_GetResolution
function.description: This function retrieves the resolution of a bitmap image.

parameters.name: bih
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPV5HEADER structure that contains bitmap header information.

parameters.name: pDpiX
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the horizontal resolution, in dots per inch.

parameters.name: pDpiY
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the vertical resolution, in dots per inch.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function. Returns S_OK if the function succeeds.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_GetResolution
function.description: This function is used to get the resolution of a BMP frame.

parameters.name: IWICBitmapFrameDecode *iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an interface for decoding bitmap frames.

parameters.name: double *pDpiX
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to a double that will hold the horizontal resolution (DPI) of the BMP frame.

parameters.name: double *pDpiY
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to a double that will hold the vertical resolution (DPI) of the BMP frame.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. It will return a code indicating success or the reason for failure.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_CopyPalette
function.description: This function copies the color palette from a bitmap frame. It handles different bitmap formats and color depths, and converts the color format if necessary.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the bitmap frame to decode

parameters.name: pIPalette
parameters.description: Pointer to the palette where the colors will be copied

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK on success, or an error code on failure

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_CopyPixels
function.description: This function decodes the pixels from a bitmap frame and copies them into a buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to a bitmap frame decoder.

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to a rectangle that specifies the portion of the bitmap to decode.

parameters.name: cbStride
parameters.description: The stride, or pitch, of the bitmap. This is the number of bytes from one row of pixels in memory to the next row of pixels in memory.

parameters.name: cbBufferSize
parameters.description: The size of the buffer that will receive the decoded pixels.

parameters.name: pbBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer that will receive the decoded pixels.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_GetMetadataQueryReader
function.description: This function is used to get the metadata query reader from a bitmap frame decode interface. However, the operation is unsupported.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the bitmap frame decode interface.

parameters.name: ppIMetadataQueryReader
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to the metadata query reader.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating that the operation is unsupported.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_GetColorContexts
function.description: This function is used to get the color contexts of a bitmap frame. However, it returns an error indicating that the operation is unsupported.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface for decoding bitmap frames

parameters.name: cCount
parameters.description: Count of color contexts

parameters.name: ppIColorContexts
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an array of color contexts

parameters.name: pcActualCount
parameters.description: Pointer to the actual count of color contexts

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating that the operation is unsupported.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_GetThumbnail
function.description: This function is used to get the thumbnail of a bitmap frame. However, it seems to always return an error indicating that the codec does not support thumbnails.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to the bitmap frame that we want to get the thumbnail of.

parameters.name: ppIThumbnail
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer where the function would store the thumbnail if it were able to get it.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a type used to represent error codes. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_CODECNOTHUMBNAIL, indicating that the codec does not support thumbnails.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_ReadUncompressed
function.description: This function reads uncompressed data from a BMP file, allocates memory for the image data, and sets the stride and start of the image data. If any error occurs during reading or memory allocation, it cleans up and returns an error code.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: A pointer to the BmpDecoder structure that contains information about the BMP file and the image data.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful. If the operation fails, it returns an error code such as E_OUTOFMEMORY or E_FAIL.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_ReadABGRasBGR
function.description: This function reads ABGR data as BGR from a BMP decoder and decodes it.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: A pointer to the BMP decoder instance

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or failure

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_ReadRGB8
function.description: This function reads an 8-bit RGB bitmap image, gets its size, reads it if uncompressed, and reverses its color order from BGR to RGB.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the BmpDecoder object which contains the information about the bitmap image to be decoded.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: ReadByte
function.description: This function reads a byte from a stream. If the end of the buffer is reached, it reads the next chunk of data from the stream into the buffer. The result is stored in the result parameter.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: The stream to read from.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: The buffer to store the data read from the stream.

parameters.name: buffer_size
parameters.description: The size of the buffer.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The current position in the buffer.

parameters.name: bytesread
parameters.description: The total number of bytes read from the stream.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: The result of the read operation is stored here.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If the operation fails, it returns E_FAIL.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_ReadRLE8
function.description: This function decodes a bitmap image that is compressed using RLE8 compression. It reads the palette and RLE data from the stream, decodes the RLE data, and stores the decoded image data in the BmpDecoder object.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: A pointer to the BmpDecoder object that contains the bitmap image data and the stream to read from.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function successfully decodes the bitmap image, E_OUTOFMEMORY if it fails to allocate memory for the image data, or E_FAIL if it fails to read the palette or RLE data from the stream.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_ReadRLE4
function.description: This function reads and decodes RLE4 compressed data from a BMP image file. It also handles the allocation and freeing of memory for the image data.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: A pointer to a BmpDecoder structure. This structure contains information about the BMP image file, including the image data, palette, and other metadata.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, E_FAIL if any other operation fails, or the error code of the failed operation.

function.name: BmpFrameDecode_ReadUnsupported
function.description: This function returns a failure status code indicating that the operation is not supported.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the BmpDecoder object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns E_FAIL indicating an unsupported operation.

function.name: BmpDecoder_ReadHeaders
function.description: This function reads the headers of a BMP file and initializes the BmpDecoder object accordingly.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: The BmpDecoder object to be initialized.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: The input stream from which the BMP file is read.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success and an error code on failure.

function.name: BmpDecoder_QueryInterface

parameters.name: iface

parameters.description: The requested interface ID

function.name: BmpDecoder_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of a BMP Decoder object and returns the updated count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICBitmapDecoder interface of the BMP Decoder object.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the updated reference count of the BMP Decoder object.

function.name: BmpDecoder_Release
function.description: This function releases the resources associated with a BMP decoder. It decrements the reference count, and if it reaches zero, it releases the stream, frees the image data and the decoder itself, and deletes the critical section.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface of the BMP decoder.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the updated reference count after decrementing.

function.name: BmpDecoder_QueryCapability
function.description: This function checks the capability of a BMP decoder. It initializes the decoder and checks if it can decode all images or not.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to the bitmap decoder.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: This is the input stream of data to be decoded.

parameters.name: capability
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a variable where the function will store the decoder's capability.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the input arguments are not valid, or other error codes if the initialization of the decoder fails.

parameters.description: Pointer to an interface for a bitmap decoder.

parameters.name: pIStream

parameters.name: cacheOptions

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the Bitmap Decoder.

parameters.description: This is an interface to the Bitmap Decoder.

parameters.name: ppIThumbnail

function.name: BmpDecoder_GetFrameCount
function.description: This function checks if the pointer to the count of frames is not null, if it is, it returns an error. If not, it sets the value pointed by pCount to 1 and returns a success status.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of IWICBitmapDecoder interface

parameters.name: pCount
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the count of frames will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation was successful, otherwise it returns an error code

function.name: BmpDecoder_GetFrame
function.description: This function retrieves a frame from a Bitmap Decoder interface, checks the validity of the index and the stream, and returns the frame if successful.

parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of a Bitmap Decoder interface

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index of the frame to be retrieved

parameters.name: ppIBitmapFrame
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a Bitmap Frame Decode interface where the retrieved frame will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if the index is not 0, and WINCODEC_ERR_FRAMEMISSING if the stream is not available

function.name: BmpDecoder_FindIconMask
function.description: This function is used to find the icon mask in a bitmap decoder. It asserts that the decoder's stream is not null, then checks if the read_data_func is BmpFrameDecode_ReadUncompressed. If true, it calculates the mask offset based on the image size and offset. If false, it sets the mask offset to 0. It also sets the topdown flag based on the stride of the image.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the BmpDecoder structure

parameters.name: mask_offset
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the function will store the calculated mask offset

parameters.name: topdown
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the function will store the topdown flag

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value
